The '''2019 Copa Libertadores final stages''' were played from 23 July to 23 November 2019.<ref name="calendar">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/calendario_2019_divulgacao_aprobado_14_08_2018_0.pdf|title=CALENDÁRIO 2019 CONMEBOL Libertadores – CONMEBOL Sudamericana – RECOPA|publisher=CONMEBOL.com}}</ref> A total of 16 teams competed in the final stages deciding the champions of the [[2019 Copa Libertadores]],<ref name="regulations">{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-conmebol-libertadores-2019-esp.pdf|title=Reglamento CONMEBOL Libertadores 2019|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|access-date=2019-04-20|archive-date=2019-04-20|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190420170654/http://www.conmebol.com/sites/default/files/reglamento-conmebol-libertadores-2019-esp.pdf|url-status=dead}}</ref> with the final played in [[Lima]], [[Peru]] at the [[Estadio Monumental "U"|Estadio Monumental]].<ref>{{cite web |title=La final única de Copa Libertadores será en Lima |url=https://www.copalibertadores.com/es/noticias/la-final-unica-de-copa-libertadores-sera-en-lima/1nwcyzxjf9o3v18d2ndqh7yquv |publisher=copalibertadores.com |language=Spanish |date=5 November 2019 |access-date=6 November 2019 |archive-date=5 November 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20191105231045/https://www.copalibertadores.com/es/noticias/la-final-unica-de-copa-libertadores-sera-en-lima/1nwcyzxjf9o3v18d2ndqh7yquv |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Format==
<section begin=Format />
Starting from the round of 16, the teams played a [[single-elimination tournament]] with the following rules:<ref name="regulations"/>
*In the round of 16, quarter-finals and semi-finals, each tie was played on a home-and-away [[two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-seeded team hosting the second leg (Regulations Article 23). If tied on aggregate, the [[away goals rule]] was used. If still tied, [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] was not played, and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] was used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 29).
*The final was played as a single match at a venue pre-selected by CONMEBOL, with the higher-seeded team designated as the "home" team for administrative purposes (Regulations Article 26). If tied after regulation, 30 minutes of extra time were played. If still tied after extra time, a penalty shoot-out was used to determine the winners (Regulations Article 30).<section end=Format />

==Draw==
<section begin=Draw />
The draw for the round of 16 was held on 13 May 2019, 20:30 [[Time in Paraguay|PYT]] ([[UTC−04:00|UTC−4]]), at the CONMEBOL Convention Centre in [[Luque]], [[Paraguay]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/la-hoja-de-ruta-la-final-de-santiago-2019|title=La hoja de ruta a la Final de Santiago 2019|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=13 May 2019}}</ref> For the round of 16, the 16 teams were drawn into eight ties (A–H) between a group winner (Pot 1) and a group runner-up (Pot 2), with the group winners hosting the second leg. Teams from the same association or the same group could be drawn into the same tie.<section end=Draw />

{{main|2019 Copa Libertadores Final}}

The final was played on 23 November 2019 at the [[Estadio Monumental "U"|Estadio Monumental]] in [[Lima]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.conmebol.com/es/final-unica-de-la-conmebol-libertadores-sera-en-el-estadio-monumental-de-lima|title=Final Única de la CONMEBOL Libertadores será en el Estadio Monumental de Lima|publisher=CONMEBOL.com|date=5 November 2019}}</ref>
